mapper.select: select s1.*,s2.DATA_SOURCE,s2.REMARK,s2.WORKFLOW_ID,s2.ORG_CODE,s2.DEPT_CODE ,s2.UPDATE_USER,s2.CREATE_USER,s2.AGENT,s2.CREATE_DEPT,s2.INTERF_CHECK_RESULT from (SELECT sum(amount) AMOUNT,sum(qty) QTY,sum(cny_amt) CNY_AMT , CEK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK INDENTIFY_MARK,HOLD_DATE,CCY,ck.STATUS, PRD_REGIST_CODE,PRODID,ck.REGIST_BANK_CODE FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK ck left join CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK cek on cek.INDENTIFY_MARK=ck.INDENTIFY_MARK and cek.REGIST_BANK_CODE=ck.REGIST_BANK_CODE where (ck.OPERATE_STATUS is null or ck.OPERATE_STATUS='01') and cek.OPERATE_STATUS='02' group by CEK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, HOLD_DATE, CCY, ck.STATUS, PRD_REGIST_CODE,PRODID,ck.REGIST_BANK_CODE )s1 left join (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK,REGIST_BANK_CODE ORDER BY update_time DESC) rn, cicc.* FROM (select cek.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK,cek.REGIST_BANK_CODE,cic.DATA_SOURCE,cic.REMARK,cic.WORKFLOW_ID,cic.ORG_CODE,cic.DEPT_CODE ,cic.UPDATE_USER,cic.CREATE_USER,cic.AGENT,cic.CREATE_DEPT,cic.INTERF_CHECK_RESULT,cic.update_time from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK cic left join CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK cek on cek.INDENTIFY_MARK=cic.INDENTIFY_MARK and cek.REGIST_BANK_CODE=cic.REGIST_BANK_CODE )cicc ) WHERE rn = 1 ) s2 on s2.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK=s1.INDENTIFY_MARK and s2.REGIST_BANK_CODE=s1.REGIST_BANK_CODE
